command: echo '--- what the researcher can see'; ls /workspace /workspace/case; for p in /workspace/sqltr /workspace/data/train/instances.jsonl /workspace/operator /etc/sqltr-arena /srv/sqltr-arena /var/run/docker.sock; do [ -e "$p" ] && echo "VISIBLE $p" || echo "hidden $p"; done; echo '--- the provider key is nowhere in reach'; (env; cat /run/secrets/* 2>/dev/null) | grep -c fake-key-for-rehearsal || true; ls /run/secrets

echo '--- network'; for target in https://api.anthropic.com https://pypi.org; do curl -s -m 6 -o /dev/null -w "$target %{http_code}\n" "$target" || echo "$target blocked"; done; for port in 5432 8080 22; do (timeout 4 bash -c "</dev/tcp/172.30.0.1/$port") 2>/dev/null && echo "host port $port OPEN" || echo "host port $port closed"; done; curl -s -m 5 "$SQLTR_TRAIN_URL/healthz" && echo ' train reachable'; curl -s -m 5 "$SQLTR_MODEL_URL/healthz" && echo ' gateway reachable'

set -e; mkdir -p /workspace/ways/rehearsal-1 /workspace/runs; cp -r /workspace/case/ways/baseline/. /workspace/ways/rehearsal-1/; python -m evaluator.search --journal "$ARENA_SEARCH_JOURNAL" propose --id rehearsal-1 --directory /workspace/ways/rehearsal-1 --hypothesis 'rehearsal: the baseline itself' --change 'none' --tokens 0 --seconds 0

set -e; ids=$(python -c "import json; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/data/train/dataset.jsonl')]; print(' '.join('--example-id '+r['id'] for r in rows[:3]+rows[-3:]))"); python -m evaluator.train submit --url "$SQLTR_TRAIN_URL" --token-file /run/secrets/train-token --journal "$ARENA_SEARCH_JOURNAL" --candidate rehearsal-1 --measurement rehearsal-1-small --dataset "$TRAIN_DATASET_ID" --conditions "$CONDITIONS_ID" --train-data /workspace/data/train/dataset.jsonl $ids | tee /workspace/runs/submit.json

set -e; id=$(python -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/workspace/runs/submit.json'))['evaluation_id'])"); for i in $(seq 1 60); do status=$(python -m evaluator.train status --url "$SQLTR_TRAIN_URL" --token-file /run/secrets/train-token --evaluation-id "$id" | python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])"); [ "$status" != RUNNING ] && break; sleep 5; done; echo "status $status"; python -m evaluator.train result --url "$SQLTR_TRAIN_URL" --token-file /run/secrets/train-token --journal "$ARENA_SEARCH_JOURNAL" --evaluation-id "$id" --measurement rehearsal-1-small --output /workspace/runs/rehearsal-1-small.json | python -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('status','metrics')}))"

python -m evaluator.search --journal "$ARENA_SEARCH_JOURNAL" status; python -m evaluator.client search-readiness --url "$SQLTR_PRIVATE_URL" --token-file /run/secrets/private-token --require-campaign --max-solutions "$MAX_SOLUTIONS" --finalists "$FINALISTS" --output-count "$OUTPUT_COUNT" --release-id "$RELEASE_ID-private" | cut -c1-300

curl -s -m 10 -H "x-api-key: $ARENA_MODEL_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","max_tokens":5,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' "$SQLTR_MODEL_URL/v1/messages"; echo; curl -s -m 10 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","max_tokens":5,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' "$SQLTR_MODEL_URL/v1/messages"; echo
